properties.name: The v0.44.0 version bump. `reflow2.toml` moved because the cut moves every version claim together (Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, reflow2.toml, AGENTS.md ×2); nothing it declares about the design changed. Accepted BEFORE the release manifest is frozen, which is the ordering the release flow warns about: freezing first captures the PRE-BUMP checksum and sends the cut back to accept the drift and re-freeze, at the cost of a gate failure and a second export.
